notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

Today, Minds of Nations, has successfully completed it's Early Access phase. We have entered Early Access on February 20, 2020 and today, 3 years later we exit that phase.

I would like to thank everyone who has helped us develop the game. Every bug report and feedback helped improve the game. THANK YOU. Everyone who has downloaded the game on steam during Early Access will keep it.

Based off of your reviews and feedback we switched the game from online-only to a focus on single-player and added multiple features.

In this time we have added numerous updates including: single-player, resources & industry, economy & trade, vassalage, win conditions, souls, influence, centralization,  unforseen consequences effect pack, chat, rankings, stories, maps, music, help videos, thousands of bugs fixed and numerous other small updates.

So what's next ? 

[EDIT 19/02/2024] Currently, I'm hoping to translate the game into multiple languages. Unfortunately, the game failed financially. For the time being any other updates are stopped except critical bug fixes.

If you are new, welcome to the game, I hope you will enjoy it and let me know if you have any issues. We have a community discord, an in-game forum and the steam forum where I regularly check for reports.

Thank you.

notes.title: New MMO Sim System, Single-Player Bug Fixes, Blitz, Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

[b]FULL RELEASE[/b]

The game will be fully released in the coming days.

Everyone that got the game on steam during early access will keep the steam game.

[b]SINGLE-PLAYER BUGS[/b]

- Quality of life improvements with 4k displays at 100% scaling.
- Forum links when not logged in.
- UI display unpleasantness on treaty pages.
- New Stories broke some bonus expiration. It is now fixed.
- You were unable to select capitals on the omnemia magna by estris map.
- A few ideological effects were not working properly.
- Texts and other minor fixes.

[b]NEW SYSTEM FOR MMO - AUTOMATIC NEW SIMS[/b]

New MMO sims will start every 3 days and end after 2 weeks [2,000 years]. When the year is 0 to 300, we usually retain more players. Thus we should maximize this period. First day will always last for 24 hours, after which you can join and start playing instantly within a 3 day window. After those 3 days, games that are not completely filled with humans will be filled with EASY Level A.I. nations.
 
I think it might be more competitive to have shorter MMO sims. We can extend this period of play after some feedback.

Some continents will have victory conditions, others will not.

The system now automatically starts new continents, pauses the game, unpauses the game, decides winners [when there are win conditions], ends existing games, moves results to your rankings page, fills continent with A.I.'s freeing me to focus on developing the game .

[b]MMO BLITZ[/b]

Blitz MMO is a faster sim for online games. It will last for 4 hours at a speed of 8 years per minute. For reference: On the single-player version you can customize speeds from 1 year / 30 seconds to 10 years / 30 seconds. While the current MMO slow version is 1 year every 10 minutes.

The BLITZ system is also done pending implementation on the live system. I'm currently considering to hold BLITZ games only on weekends due to the size of our current player-base.

I'd like to test it a few more times before releasing it into the wild.

Thanks

notes.title: Single-Player "LIVE PORT" error, Heraldry Error

Please make sure you have version 1.3.7 at the bottom of your front page, on the steam game.

notes.title: Single-Player
notes.notes:
Hello,

After quite a bit of time.. single-player is finally here !

Most of the update has been completed by June if I remember correctly.

Since then however, I spent quite a lot of time debugging and tweaking settings. There have been 1,210 bugs and tweaks to the A.I., game-play, UI, backend etc. Many of the bugs crossover with the MMO too. So that's a plus.

This is why development has taken soooo long. 

There are many settings you can adjust. From karmic years / siege, unlimited conquests, spawn province, multiple levels of difficulties, game lengths, win-conditions, etc, etc. All these had to be tested properly. Default settings for multiplayer were not fun enough, so they had to be adjusted for single-player.  Win conditions were affected by those customizations so I had to continously tweak them a bit with gameplay.. The A.I. had lots of questionable decisions for a while. A.I.'s movement had to be improved. 

Anyway, it's here. I hope the wait will have been worth it. 

Have fun, and let me know if you encounter bugs.

A few technical notes:

[b]PORTS[/b]

The game runs two parallel services. One for the backend where the A.I.'s decision and internal works and one for the stream that connects to the U.I. 

You will need ports: 24931 & 24932 open. If those are not open [or for some other reason the game cant run the server], you will be greeted with a window to choose other ports.

[b]SAVE FOLDER AND DEBUGGING[/b]

Games are saved in the following folder:

C:\Users\[YOUR WINDOWS USERNAME]\Documents\My Games\Minds of Nations\saved_games\ 

Each sim creates its own folder with several .db files. If the game can't save the files there it may fail.

Also, if you encounter a bug, a good way to get it debugged by me, would be to zip the folder and send it via wetransfer.com to me.


Thank you,
I'll probably make a better announcement in the future.

notes.title: Fixed Effects Are Back !!!
notes.notes:
Hello,

After the trade update, some weeks ago, the fixed effects pack had been disabled. We needed to remove obsolete effects in light of the new variables employed by the algos of the trade update.

Today, the fixed effects pack is back ! We will alternate effect packs from now on. Some continents will have fixed and other random effects.

Most of the continents in this first week will feature fixed effects.

We've added or modified a few hundred effects.

[b]We've added 7 governance questions.[/b]

[list]
[*] How do we avoid clientelism in state institutions ? And at the same time create a competent civil service.
[*] How do we break up powerful familial clans and kinship groups ?
[*] How do we deal with with the fact that plots of land will become smaller and smaller as families split their plots in order to pass the inheritance to their children ?
[*] How do we guarantee state loans ?
[*] How do we raise capital in case of need or emergency ?
[*] How do we avoid general institutional decay and the technocratic disconnect ?
[*] How do we increase legibility and simplification ? The state always tries to make society and the resources it controls more legible.
[/list]

[b]And 6 societal questions and 1 new collection [ "Worldviews & Myths" ]:[/b]

[list]
[*] What are the elites' views about the common folk ?
[*] What are the common folk's views about the leadership / government ?
[*] What's the appropriate behavior on the street with women you do not know ?
[*] What do people believe about the future ?
[*] What do people believe about our origins ?
[*] Thoughts on our relationship with the past and present:
[*] Exceptionalist views:
[/list]

Custom answers in the fixed effect pack now draw effects from the entire directory of effects in the game. They are no longer limited to 10 effects. You are however limited to a single use.

Custom answers are no longer free if they do not have any effects.

We've added hundreds of new answers too.

We've fixed textual and coloring problems with some of the effects.

We've added some cosmetic descriptions.

We've changed the Insight Meditation's stages to a more detailed list.

We've improved the bibliography of the game.

Thank you!

notes.title: 1.2.81 - Some changes to the previous update based on community feedback
notes.notes:
1. After a conquest the influence cost per 20 gold is 0.1. Which increases every 50 years by 5 gold after year 432 [when the peaceful context expires].

2. After a conquest the influence cost per 20,000 food is 0.1. This also updates every 50 years by 5,000 food after year 432 [when the peaceful context expires].

3. They are also upgradable effects:

"Gold for 0.1 influence when suing for peace"
"Food for 0.1 influence when suing for peace".

4. The person that offers food/gold has to pay the influence cost. This is done in this manner because @Not a new name 2 found an exploit. You could offer a lot of food and drain the other nation of influence. 

5. Peace offer summary has been fixed. It had a few bugs.

notes.title: Idea cost. Influence cost. Trade limits on prestige products. Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Adjustments to metas, small tweaks and other bug fixes:

1. Conquering an unconnected capital now costs 20 Influence with 5 Centralization.

The old strategy of conquering far away inactive as soon as the peaceful context ended was back.

2. Conquering a connected capital now costs 10 Influence with 3 Centralization.

3. Idea costs have been increased. Quite significantly for the late stages of a sim. We should not reach thousands of ideas added again.

4. You cannot sell someone else's prestige products.

A number of users would move around a single prestige product. Middlemen would earn as much as the creator. This had to stop.

5. Clearing prestige products now requires only 1,000.

6. Clearing a prestige product now yields 1 influence.

7. Famous Products ranking is now based on most nations that have cleared your at least 1 of your prestige products.

8. Prestige products can now be cleared 10 times each.

9. Design fixes on iOS.

10. Design Fixes on Steam.

11. Missing nation flag during peace offers.

12. It now costs 1 influence for every 200 gold you extract during peace negotiations.

13. It now costs 1 influence for every 200,000 food you extract during peace negotiations.

Farming gold thru conquest was a 0-cost strategy. 

14. Rankings aesthetic improved and bug fixed.

15. Protectorate used to cost too much in gold.

16. When sending a peace offer you'll get lots more information on why it was not auto-accepted.

17. You were unable to send an insult treaty sometimes.

18. Effects would not expire if they were predefined [ unforeseen consequences ].

19. Conquering a province would not always increase prestige product yield.

20. Destroyed nations would not close ongoing trades.

21. Total agricultural land was not updating after conquests.

22. Province fertility would drop into the negative if environmental degradation was left unchecked.

23. Hours until the next technological level is reached has been removed from the map UI.

notes.title: DEVLOG: Jobs, Algos, Trades & Resources
notes.notes:
Happy new year !

Just a quick update on the work I'm doing on the game's economy.
I did promise to post here more often.. [b]This update is not yet ready[/b], mind you. 

So, here we go:

[b]EXPONENTIALITY REMOVED & PEGGING ALGOS TO THE NEW ECONOMIC SYSTEM[/b]

As you may have noticed, in the previous algos, food & currency were tied to population size. This has led to an impossible situation with exponential growth. Last summer, we had capped food by land fertility and size, but this was not enough.

Food will now be extracted from specialists / large estates that create a surplus, while everyone else is doing subsistence agriculture or hunter-gathering. Providing enough food for their family only. These specialists are assigned using the new "jobs" system.

Currency [gold] will be extracted mainly from trade, but also from other vectors: State monopolies, taxation, fees and penalties etc. Trade however will become the major income vector with over 65% of the revenue.

[b]Trade & Resources[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36609442/e463f0f78fe2c9e587bc0a63a2df480f477d7ea2.png[/img]

Resources are found in provinces by acquisition or exploration. They can then be manufactured into other types of resources using jobs. They can be traded or used to unlock tiers of your economy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36609442/d690554f6009912f6e40bff1a5255219ecbab8d8.png[/img]

As you can see in the screenshots above, clay can be used to produce ceramics and clay tablets which in turn can be used to unlock industry.

We also use some more creative approaches to unlock economic options. For example, you can start the tobacco smokes industry with lifespan and the sugary drinks industry with diseases [diabetes]. Both of these indices affect population growth but provide tremendous revenues. It's up to you..

[b]154 resources unlock 183 Jobs which unlock Olympic games, Prestige Items and more[/b]

These jobs in turn unlock other things like: Olympic Games, Prestige Items [think Baurdeaux wine] and National Prestige Military Units [ think Ottoman Janissariesor Mughal Elephants ].

Jobs, of course, affect other items in our new algos: population loss due to disease, revenue from creativity, lifespan, average strength, stamina, lifestyle and others.



I am midway through this update and expect to have it finished within 3-7 weeks.

Current development status and more screens are available in our trello: https://trello.com/b/D5o5XpJC/minds-of-nations-todolist-added-august-1st-2020-work-before-that-date-is-missing
I am doing work on the UI side, half of the backend side is completed. Resource and job data plus graphics has also been completed.
More screenshots and videos soon.

Hope everyone has been safe this year.
All the best in the new year to you and your family :)

notes.title: SIMULATION #5 – New small & large maps ! Manpower. Updates. Fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello,

Please update your steam, android, or iOS app to view the new maps

We've added several new maps. These maps feature some new styles different from the one in our previous maps.

It has taken most of the last sim to finish these. All this time however was not in vain, as these new techniques developed can be used over and over for new maps at a much quicker pace now.

I'm hoping before the full release of the game to reach about 30 maps.

I've also used this opportunity to update the variable side of the continent generation feature:

- Arable \ agricultural land has been nerfed further to:

— 42% for capital regions

— 38% for fertille regions

— 25% for hilly regions

— 20% for mountainous regions

— 17% for regions with white peaks

- Landmass number has also been implemented in the map creation software [which I'm also hopin g to make available for everyone soon].

Other changes & fixes:

- UPDATE: You can now hide flags of other units. Useful in case you were unable to click your desired destination.

- UPDATE: you can now choose to spawn on small 8-20 player-maps.

- UPDATE: new map styles. new maps.

- UPDATE: maximum arable land / province has been cut in half.

- UPDATE: manpower recovery is much quicker. if you lose all of your manpower, you can recover it within 80-100 years. The trigger for this is 15% or more losses from your MAXIMUM achieved manpower numbers.

- UPDATE: manpower starts at 4% now and with ideas it can be increased to 11%. It used to start at 22% and end towards 100%.

- UPDATE: ideas that have manpower improvements cost 3 times the usual cost.

- UPDATE: energy algo was changed to favour peaceful states.

- UPDATE: revolt strength has been decreased to be in-line with the new manpower %.

- UPDATE: larger battles will now be a bit slower and favour better units.

- UPDATE: food produce bonuses from ideology were decreased from a maximum of x5 to x2.

- FIX: This previous sim we had increased the number of karmic years per siege. There was an issue where these years were also deducted from the nation being sieged.

Since the number of commoner karmic years was increased to 100, it was too large of a bonus for nations that got sieged. In this next sim, this later bonus was changed to only 2 years.

- FIX: Starvation penalties were not applied, apparently. This is now fixed.

UPCOMING TODOLIST

SMALLER UPDATES [hopefuly sometime this next sim]:

- Update province integrations.

- Fix custom questions.

- Fix the “support rebells” function.

- Add the “conquered nation” as a rebel faction.

- Add a new random effects pack.

- Explain the technology effects better.

- Bring back the remove ideology buttons.

- Mute chat button.

- Add 2 extra maps.

LARGER UPDATES [next 2-6 sims]:

- Blitz version with human and also basic A.I. empires.

- Trade.

- Jobs.

- End-game crisis.

- Single player.

- Better tutorial and video explanations.

- More stories & maps.

Thank you !

Let's have a great sim #5 in a new environment provided by these new maps we've worked during sim #4

notes.notes:
NEW SIMULATION [#2] - STATE OF THE GAME ADDRESS [& UPDATES]

Hello,

Yesterday we've concluded the first simulation. We've had quite a few bugs. We were able to fix quite a few still [list at the bottom of the post]:



Today, at 22:00 GMT, we will start the second simulation [ *but you can create your nation now and get acquainted with the new updates* - the sim is not changing years until 22:00 GMT - but everything else works ].
Four major updates are already here and several are being worked on:

1) Astral Probing - a new unit that is used to bring souls to your nation.
In the previous simulation souls were tied to provinces and regions. This led to a nations building wide [attacking and expanding becoming way too powerful and leading every single ranking].
In this new simulation, you have to create a special unit that "gathers"/"brings" souls to your nation-school.
This should separate the game into two rankings at the end of the sim:
- The white ranking: sophistication and freed souls.
- The black ranking: battles, country size, etc.

This unit is of three typs: Lucid Dreamers, Shammans and Wandering Recluses. Each has can find different things in the astral dimension.
The later two can also find gameplay peaceful contexts.

This update is a 2nd update after the "Tools for the Peaceful" update that addresses issues for the lovers of peace out there.

2) Maximum units mechanic has changed.
You can now create 3 civillian units [ explorers, colonists and astral probers ] and 3 military units.
1 civillian unit is added every 500 years.
While military units can be added using ideology [the previous options were changed to this].

3) Idea cost.
3a) Categories no longer cost a single idea.
3b) Answer cost goes up based on game year - not country size.

UPCOMING UPDATES

I wanted to add several other updates, but I was unable to finish them in time.
They will be added *during* this second simulation [if I finish them in time]:

- Continent chat.
- A separation and randomisation between ideas & effects. [ https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753527487239031253/ ]
- Hidden colonisation effects being random.
- Small maps for mobile.
- Cassus bellis as percentage after 30 provinces. The late game is boring for people looking to conquer.
- Rankings page for previous simulation.
- Food production limited by province area and fishing units.
- Phone push notifications.
- Login bonuses.

Once those are done we will continue with:

- BLITZ version [2-3 hour games].
- Better graphics for buildings and provinces.
- Many more maps.
- Many more stories.
- Translating the gam into YOUR mother tongue [and mine].

Of course, bugs will be the priority.

Thank you !

- “Support rebels” action would block the nation page from loading.
- Inactive treaties were shown on the treaty page.
- Nation page would not open if the nation in question had any kind of treatywith … a deleted nation.

FEB21 > BUGFIXES – suing for peace, truces
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753527064359173092/
- FIX: If you had an expired truce you were unable to redeclare war. It should be fixed.
- FIX, When suing for peace, had you chosen the amount of food or gold BEFORE selecting a nation the “trade” would not be saved.
- FIX, Inability to send provinces to allies.
- FIX, Unable to declare war had you had previous non-aggressor treaties.
- FIX, truces weren't expiring.



FEB 20: Performance update, bug fixes
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753526853883625531/
- Issued a huge performance update. The game became laggy after 40+ provinces. It works fine now.
- War list showed inactive wars.
- Active peace offers included, unanswerable peace offers.
- Battle was hanging when one of the units did not have a unit/type. This is a very niche issue caused by malformed server settings which should not happen, but it took me 1 hour to find it and I have to put it here.
- Cancelling a peaceful context would put your state in perpetual peace.

notes.title: Feb 17-18-19, Updates & Fixes
notes.notes:
Description below includes backend patches which may have been active already.

FEB 19
- Provinces occupied by revolting units can now be relieved. There was a bug.
- Immigration and emigration disabled for now. They were OP.
- There was a bug with ideas going missing after custom options were added.
- Truce length after wars has been increased.
- Truce length in case of cancelling alliances, defensive pacts and non-aggression pacts increased.
- Slightly decreased the number of provinces that can be taken during wars.

Working on stories bug and notifications for PMs now.

FEB 18
- I've added a cronjob that backups the database every 48 hours, 24 hours and 6 hours. We should have nice rollback posibilities from now on.
- It was possible to declare war when an active truce was present. It's fixed.
- There was a bug with accepting peace offers. It's fixed.
- There was a bug that ignored a specific form of malformed request. It's fixed.
- People available to go off nation going negative. Typo in the algorithm for the "elected leadership" option.
- People off nation going negative. It would add both army size and personnel to the variable when army disbanded. Personnel is included in army size.
- Capped an overpowered wonder.
- Fixed several malformed effects that threw errors.

FEB 17

- Units would not disband when food reached 0. [Yesterday's fix only lowered the supply years]. I found myself with hundreds of notifications that the unit would disband, but it wasn't doing that. It's fixed now.

- Off nation numbers were off. It was because of the above issue. The unit would attempt to disband multiple times lowering the off-nation flag. Since the unit did not actually disband the off nation flag only got lowered.

- We found an obscure bug that permitted a huge number of effects to be applied to a nation at once. 10 States were overpowered so they will be retired later in the day. I've contacted their users.

notes.title: Update & fix: Colonizing Islands, Cancelling Constructions

A few other fixes were made.

Thanks.
